concerns.text: SC-001 requires comparing the observed proportion of rejections against a high percentile of the null distribution to validate significance. While T020 generates the null distribution and T021 calculates an empirical p-value, there is no explicit task to perform the final statistical comparison (proportion vs. high percentile) and record the pass/fail status required to satisfy SC-001's success criterion.

SC-004 requires measuring total pipeline runtime against a 'predefined execution time limit'. No task exists to define, document, or enforce this specific limit (e.g., 6 hours) in code or configuration. T041a profiles bottlenecks but does not establish the target constraint against which success is measured.

FR-007 requires sensitivity analysis across a 'configurable set of confidence thresholds'. T035 hardcodes the loop to `[500, 700, 900]` defined in `config.py` but lacks a task to implement the actual configuration loading logic or validation that allows the user to modify this set dynamically as implied by the requirement.

FR-004 mandates centrality algorithms complete within 30 minutes for networks ≤ 25,000 nodes. T016 implements k-sampling only for networks > 5,000 nodes. There is no task defining a fallback strategy for networks between 5,000 and 25,000 nodes that might still exceed the time limit with exact calculation.
